Game Overview

Zombies! is a zombie title where become a relentless zombie slayer and climb the ranks from novice to insane. Dive into exhilarating game modes like King of the Hill and Capture the Flag. Will you brave the hardcore challenge with no regeneration? Unearth your purpose as you decimate the endless undead horde.
